headline: Sensex surges 990 points to reclaim 83,000 and Nifty hits 25,500 led by auto and bank stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong buying interest broadens across key sectors like auto and banking
Significant FII inflows provided liquidity and boosted investor sentiment
Markets rebounded from an initial dip caused by US Federal Reserve rate hike signals
Positive momentum in auto stocks powered the Sensex to cross the 83,000 mark
whatHappening: Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points to reclaim the 83,000 level after a choppy start
Nifty 50 successfully reclaimed the 25,500 mark during the trading session
IndiGo announced a major expansion in Southeast Asia with increased flights to key cities
Sebi is considering a Capacity Building Network to strengthen the role of independent directors
summary: The Indian market staged a strong recovery as the Sensex surged 990 points to cross the 83,000 mark. Gains were driven by the auto and banking sectors, alongside significant FII inflows, helping Nifty reclaim 25,500. Despite an initial dip due to US Fed rate concerns, broad-based buying supported the rebound.
